articles.summary: Ekho’s new Protection Menu brings F&I directly into the checkout experience—online or in-store—so dealers can present curated coverage bundles in just a few clicks. Powered by dynamic logic, it adapts in real time to each buyer and dealer, delivering personalized protection options without slowing down the sale. The result is higher penetration, fewer handoff gaps, and a seamless, transparent experience that keeps both dealers and buyers in control.
articles.title: Embedded F&I is Now Live
